intro: Andron Gant is a reclusive, frequently intoxicated Forsaken residing in the murky depths of the Apothecarium in the Undercity, handling occasional research commissions and relic recoveries for local scholars.

p: Lounging amidst the noxious fumes of the Apothecarium, Andron Gant rarely ventures beyond the safety of the Undercity's stone walls. To the casual observer, he appears to be little more than a drunken scholar, occasionally hiring adventurous couriers to retrieve obscure relics like the Tablet of Markri from distant shores on behalf of local mages.
